subject.title: [Feature]: Add one-way dispatch mode for A2A handoffs without reply-back ping-pong

question: What public one-way A2A dispatch contract should OpenClaw add for `sessions_send` handoffs?
rationale: The missing behavior is source-proven, but the fix changes model-facing session tool semantics and overlaps structured handoff, announce suppression, and cron session-delivery design; automation should not choose the durable API shape alone.

options.title: Add an explicit dispatch mode
options.body: Add an additive `sessions_send` mode or equivalent option that keeps current conversation behavior as the default and skips reply-back/announce only when requested.

options.title: Create a separate delivery primitive
options.body: Add a new one-way session enqueue/deliver tool so conversation and dispatch semantics cannot be confused by models or callers.

options.title: Fold into broader handoff protocol work
options.body: Defer this issue until a canonical A2A handoff contract covers dispatch, structured skip, announce routing, and cron session output together.

recommendation.title: Add an explicit dispatch mode
recommendation.body: Add an additive `sessions_send` mode or equivalent option that keeps current conversation behavior as the default and skips reply-back/announce only when requested.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest feature-history signal across the sessions_send/A2A surface and is best positioned to choose the durable API contract.
